summary: Timer Warning Email and Lock Account features fully tested. All 10 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified: Timer column shows days/hours format, 'Send Timer Warning' dropdown option shows only for users with timer, 'Lock Account' option shows only for non-locked users, Lock dialog works with reason textarea and disabled/enabled button states, 'locked' status badge displays with red styling.

issues: Minor: Console warnings about HTML nesting (<tr> inside <span>) - cosmetic issue from React dev tools, doesn't affect functionality

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test users during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Timer Warning Email and Lock Account features are fully implemented and tested. The locked user 'Timer Test' (timertest2@test.com) correctly shows 'locked' status badge and cannot log in. Users with timer configured show 'Send Timer Warning' option in dropdown. Lock Account dialog requires a reason and sends notification email.

backend: POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/send-email?email_type=timer_warning - sends warning email with dynamic remaining time
POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/send-email?email_type=timer_warning - returns 400 if user has no timer configured
POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/lock - locks account with reason, returns success
POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/lock - returns 400 if no reason provided
POST /api/auth/login - returns 403 with lock reason for locked users
GET /api/admin/users - returns users with timer_duration_hours and lock_reason fields
frontend: Admin Users list shows 'Timer' column with days/hours format (e.g. '6d 20h')
Admin Users dropdown shows 'Send Timer Warning' only for users with timer_duration_hours set
Admin Users dropdown shows 'Lock Account' for non-locked users
Admin Users dropdown does NOT show 'Lock Account' for already-locked users
Lock Account dialog appears with reason textarea when clicked
Lock Account button is disabled when no reason entered, enabled when reason provided
'locked' status badge shows correctly in user list with red styling (bg-red-200 text-red-800)
